notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Hamza.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat from step 3.
